name: dropdown-menu
useFor: Use for actions on one thing behind a single control (an agent's row actions, the account menu), and for small option sets with DropdownMenuCheckboxItem or DropdownMenuRadioItem. Mark a destructive action with variant="destructive" and keep it last, after a separator.
constraints: Navigation between pages in a dropdown
More than one level of submenu
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): nav rows (38px, 8px corners, filled glyphs, lilac current row), section labels (Channels), the raised panel
